## Open-Source Projects
- [LogSentinel](https://github.com/faizi-cybsec/LogSentinel): Zero-dependency Python SOC log analyzer, Sigma-style detection rule engine (match, threshold, sequence), MITRE ATT&CK mapping, offline IOC enrichment, and JSON/CSV/HTML incident reporting.
- [PasswordGuardian](https://github.com/faizi-cybsec/PasswordGuardian): C++17 cybersecurity toolkit for password strength analysis, Shannon entropy, crack-time estimation, and privacy-preserving HIBP k-Anonymity breach checking.
- [file-hash-checker](https://github.com/faizi-cybsec/file-hash-checker): Python MD5, SHA-1, and SHA-256 file integrity verification tool for digital forensics.
- [secure-password-vault](https://github.com/faizi-cybsec/secure-password-vault): Offline Android password manager built with Capacitor and Android Studio.
